settings.max_tokens_hint: The summary is written in a single call: the whole transcript goes in, which is why the length budget can be respected. This is a ceiling for the output only — the real limit is the word budget, which follows the style and the length of the transcript.
settings.cards_on: Flashcards (Anki) — optional: shows the Cards tab and the deck export
settings.slides_hint: Slides are context for summaries (terms and formulas spelled right) and for cards: parsing and OCR always run locally. The VLM (Ollama) makes formulas and diagrams on complex pages readable; embeddings assign the pages to the lectures. No API key comes into play until you press “Generate cards”.
settings.vision_auto: yes, if the model reads them
settings.match_hint: A page enters the context only if it passes the threshold and beats the second lecture by at least the margin; otherwise it stays unlinked and does not pollute the cards.
settings.providers_hint: Keys are encrypted at rest with a key stored in data/secret.key and are never returned by the API.
settings.storage_hint: Files used by path are never copied and never deleted by the app. Copies uploaded from the browser are removed after a successful transcription.
settings.runtime_hint: Models stay in RAM between jobs to skip the load time. Keep a maximum of two: the VRAM is shared.
prov.unreadable_notice: The saved key can no longer be decrypted (data/secret.key changed). Paste the key again and press Save.
prov.reasoning: This looks like a reasoning model. It may spend the whole token budget thinking and return nothing: the agent would then fall back to the fallback model below.
settings.intro: Defaults for new transcriptions, the LLM providers used for summaries, and where the data lives.
costs.empty: No summary or correction was run in this month. Pick another month, or go back to all months.
costs.title: LLM costs
costs.intro: Whisper runs on this machine and costs nothing. What has a price is the optional work done by a model: summaries, course guides, questions and flashcards. Every call is recorded on the job that made it, at the time it was made.
costs.died: A job that died halfway still appears under its course: its tokens were spent all the same.
costs.local_hint: Local models cost nothing at the provider, but they still report tokens: the numbers are real even when the price is not.
about.access_value: 127.0.0.1 only — not reachable from the network
about.title: What runs, and what leaves this machine
about.intro: Trascrivi is a local application. It listens on the loopback address, stores everything under the data/ directory next to the code, and sends no telemetry. There is no account and no cloud service.
about.llm_title: The one exception: the LLM features
about.llm_text: Transcription itself is offline — Whisper runs on this machine and the audio never leaves it. The LLM features (summaries, course guide, questions, flashcards) are different: when you run one, the transcript text is sent to the LLM provider you configured in Settings, over that provider's API, with your own key. It runs only when you ask for it (the summary checkbox of New lecture included). To keep everything local, point a provider at a model running on this machine and disable the others.
about.keys_hint: API keys are encrypted at rest with data/secret.key. If that file is deleted the saved keys become unreadable and must be entered again — the app says so on the provider card instead of failing silently.
about.kb_save: Save the transcript you are editing
about.kb_close: Close a menu or a dialog
about.legal: There are no legal pages to read: this app has no users other than the person running it, collects nothing, and shares nothing. The licence of the source code governs its use.
boot.failed_hint: The page loaded but the API did not answer. Check that the server is still running in the console window, then reload.
settings.auto_vocab_hint: When the initial prompt of a lecture is empty, Whisper gets the technical terms of the course slides and glossary: names and acronyms come out right more often.
course.low_coverage_hint: {rate} characters per minute, much less than the other lectures of the course: parts of the audio were probably skipped. Re-transcribe it with VAD off.
